Overtime is included if played. If the first touchdown is a passing touchdown, only the player credited with the receiving touchdown will settle as the First Touchdown Scorer. The player credited with the passing touchdown will settle to No. If the player is inactive or does not play, this market will resolve to "No". If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50. All statistics are based on the official NFL game book as published on NFL.com.
